body.p: The witch. There lives a man, a hunter. The hunter is called the hunter because he does not stay home during the day, he only hunts wild reindeer during the day, he is hunting. One day his wife said: "A man came from somewhere, a human or someone else, his hair are dangling." She sees that a man is the size of a man. She sees: he entered the tent. He opened the door, she sees. At that time, we didn't use the lamp, apparently it was light. In a tent, people used open fire, her fire is on. And that man, it seems, is not a human, he is not a human. He is not a human. Only the hair of the body is his clothes, the whole body is hairy, the hair is long and hangs out. I do not know how they understood one another. I don't know if she spoke Enets language. The Enets woman understood her friend, she seems to say so, says so: âEnets woman, come to my tent, come to visit me.â. The Enets woman thinks: âIâll go with her, but she doesnât seem to be a human, she will do something with me, she can also kill me,â â she thinks. At that time, there were Enets people, well, the Enets woman said so: âYou say, come to my tent, perhaps I will come,â â she said. The Enets woman unwillingly put on her clothes, the clothes that she was wearing were home clothes, she put on her belt. The witch keeps insisting, she said: "Let's go," â and all this time she sings a song to her friend. If the Enets woman understands her friend's words, then that's how she sings. Enets woman, let's go // let's go to my tent // in the peat tent // the fat is trembling // the meat is there // let's go to my tent! After some time, the Enets woman put on her belt. They went. The Enets woman looks attentively to where they are going. After a while, on the shore of the lake peat dangles. Her tent is under the peat there. They got in there. This is her peat tent. In her peat tent, in the peat hole there is such a meat: different bones, bones are scattered. They are collected in her peat tent. Garbage from old camps, garbage, leftovers of ravens â that's the kind of meat a witch has. After a while, the witch woman's cauldron boiled. What sort of good meat will they eat? She says to her friend: "It would be good for you to eat in our peat tent, the fat is trembling.[ShA:] The glossing of ÉlÊ¼udaÊ is very unsure. Why would a witch's meat be good? Maybe it's garbage from the old camps, maybe it's the leftovers of a raven, leftovers of people, sick people. Her, sick, leftovers, apparently. The witch's meat is like that, just like that. Well, let it be. The witch said: âEnets woman, Enets woman, tomorrow Iâll probably come to visit you, Iâll probably come to your place, but now go home.â. She also said to her friend: âWill you find your tent?â. The Enets woman said: âOf course, I will find my tent, I will find my tent, after all.â. The witch said: "I'll come to you tomorrow, perhaps." Then the Enets woman said unwillingly: "Well, come tomorrow." Like a good person, the witch said: âSo, donât get lost, I have to come for a visit tomorrow, you will feed me.â. The Enets woman put on her belt and left. She has some thoughts, she carries a knife somewhere in her bosom, she hid it from her friend in her bosom. She came home. Her fellow hunter, of course, came. The day finished obviously. She said to her friend: "Tomorrow the witch will come, the witch will come for a visit." Earlier, during the day, she took me to visit her tent. She told her friend what kind of meat was there: garbage of former camps, excrements, such kinds of meat. The hunter said: âWill this one be a good person?â. The hunter said: âI donât know the witch, I've never seen one like that.â. But the hunter is a person who is occupied with hunting. In the morning he got up, put on his skis, and went through the forest again. The Enets man hunts only partridges. And, well, the woman stayed alone again. After all, she is waiting: "The witch was supposed to come to visit." The Enets woman said: âShe will do something to me, will she eat me, will she kill me while my friend is away. What can I do? When she comes, I will do this: her hair is long, she has no clothes. She doesn't have any clothes, it seems like it's not bad to set her body on fire." After a while, the Enets woman sees: she is coming, she is following yesterday's footsteps. The Enets woman has prepared such things: you can't say that, like now, kerosene, which is used to light a fire, so that it quickly flames up. While the witch was away, she prepared dry firewood, she chose dry firewood, she chopped it thinly. When she saw the witch, her friend piled such firewood in the fire. The witch sat down to the opposite side, in the direction of the fire, yesterday she also sat there. She started to speak with her friend. The Enets woman probably had something flaming up quickly, a torch. So she lit the fire quickly. The sparks of this fire scattered in different directions. This witch stayed without clothes, the witch. Now she said so: âEnets woman, Enets woman, you have already done this to me, you will see me next time I come!â. She left without clothes. The witch has not come since then. That's all.
